item.title: Eli Lilly Verv-102 Gene Editing Cholesterol Trial
item.description:
• Summary: Eli Lilly and Verve Therapeutics are advancing Verv-102, an investigational gene editing therapy targeting elevated cholesterol. Early phase 1 trial data were reported, showing promise in durably lowering LDL cholesterol through a one-time treatment. The therapy uses base editing to inactivate the PCSK9 gene in the liver, a validated target for cholesterol reduction. These results mark a significant step toward a potential functional cure for hypercholesterolemia.
  • MoAs: Gene editing (base editing) to inactivate the PCSK9 gene, leading to increased LDL receptor expression and reduced circulating LDL cholesterol.
  • Sources: STAT News
